imageQa.note: Intentional image-free layouts; no new or changed editorial, affiliate, or product imagery.

searchConsole.signal: Eight homepage impressions, zero clicks, average position 3.125 and no query rows
searchConsole.decision: Too little evidence for a Data-led page. The batch instead adds three unrelated evergreen intents and strengthens crawl paths from established Grooming, Style and Life guides.
searchConsole.ignored: The homepage-only sample was not treated as a topic signal; the externally reported 26 submitted and zero indexed sitemap URLs were treated as a discovery warning, not proof that the current 147-page publication sitemap is invalid.

monetization.placement: All three pages remain commerce-free: clinical suitability, tailoring and local rental terms, and charitable verification require exact facts that a generic retail link would not improve.

authority.action: Created a source-backed hair-change record that separates observation from diagnosis and captures timeline, distribution, scalp signs, medication and supplement context, exact product identity, photographs and clinician questions in one reusable handoff.
authority.cluster: Men’s grooming decisions, scalp and hair-care evidence, and appropriate professional escalation
authority.opportunity: American Academy of Dermatology patient-education and FDA Division of Drug Information review opportunities logged; no outreach sent.

diversity: A health-adjacent grooming record, a formalwear rent-versus-buy decision and a consumer-protection donation checklist answer three unrelated questions across Grooming, Style and Life. Search Console did not support a Data-led item, so the portfolio uses one Authority-expansion and two Exploration pages.

pages.title: Men’s Hair Loss Guide: Record Change and Prepare for Care
pages.searchIntent: Document men’s hair loss or shedding, distinguish observations from diagnosis, evaluate product and treatment claims, and prepare useful questions and evidence for a qualified clinician

pages.title: Rent or Buy a Tuxedo? A Fit, Cost and Timing Guide
pages.searchIntent: Decide whether to rent or buy a tuxedo by dress code, event frequency, fit, package contents, alteration limits, timing, total cost, care, return terms and ownership burden

pages.title: Charity Donation Verification Checklist: Identity, Impact and Records
pages.searchIntent: Verify a charity before donating by checking legal identity, tax-deductibility, official contact details, fundraiser relationships, program claims, payment route, privacy and receipt records
